expected: Review without default; exact request checks only that release

scenario: Review, fail, missing tool, native error or cancellation

scenario: Invalid input, shell metacharacters, unsupported selector or unavailable install adapter
expected: No shell evaluation or file changes; unsupported operations fail before network

scenario: Native stub writes progress then waits for stdin before exit
expected: Progress reaches its native stream before exit; no whole-process buffering

scenario: Credential-bearing provider error or terminal controls in upstream identifiers
expected: Own diagnostics omit credentials and raw bodies; identifiers cannot inject terminal instructions

scenario: Check outside Git without project config, manifest, lockfile or native tool
expected: Built-in age/Markdown defaults and normal shared package-only checks; no local tool executes

expected: Equivalent aliases yield identical check requests/results and manager-specific native argv; Kotlin and Java share Maven checks but keep distinct install intent; unavailable operations fail before network

scenario: All must-have language check/install capabilities in the matrix
expected: Same flags and result/exit semantics; fixture-backed identity/date/advisory evidence; exact checked dependency added by correct default manager; skeleton stubs do not satisfy delivery

scenario: Optional shared-ecosystem check support with no install adapter
expected: Check succeeds under normal shared evidence policy; install exits 2 before check/network/mutation; adding a language alias introduces no policy fork

scenario: Pub/Swift missing release date or default; Swift ambiguous URL/tag/version identity
expected: Missing evidence yields review and blocks install; invalid identity is rejected; no fallback, project execution or fabricated clean result

scenario: Kotlin/Gradle or Swift native integration with exact checked version
expected: Stub/fixture tests verify declaration edits where needed, preservation of unrelated content, correct manager invocation and exit propagation; no check duplication or manual-only success

scenario: Missing, partial and complete project defaults; explicit overrides including zero and markdown
expected: Built-ins fill absent fields; file supplies defaults; explicit flags win; --json and --format json agree and conflicting flags exit 2

scenario: Nested cwd with nearest config; multiple ancestors; .git file/directory boundary; standalone cwd with ancestor config but no Git boundary
expected: Inside Git use nearest file up to boundary inclusive; outside Git use only cwd and ignore ancestor configs; no merge; native cwd stays at invocation directory

scenario: Unreadable or invalid CUE; unknown fields; negative/fractional age; invalid format; imports or nonconcrete values

scenario: Configured format json on install and explicit install formatting flags
expected: Configured age applies to the one pre-install check; configured format is ignored; native streams remain raw; explicit --json or --format exits 2

scenario: Passing check followed by missing manager, host executable, wrapper or known runtime
expected: Exit 1 before any install mutation; no automatic installation or fallback; stderr identifies missing component and gives brief macOS guidance plus an official URL; aliases share the same guidance

scenario: Older installed manager or pinned wrapper; explicit older package version or too-young latest package
expected: No tool-version gate, forced upgrade or latest-release request; respect native/project constraints and explicit package identity; shared age policy still applies

scenario: Check-only invocation or blocked pre-install check with no manager installed
expected: No local manager lookup/execution required by check; blocked package result cannot launch manager preflight/delegation or mutate declarations

scenario: Mixed Go/Python repo with parent manifests and a nested module
expected: Each list selector reads only its own invocation-relative inputs; missing local manifest exits 2; no ancestor/subproject scan

scenario: Direct declarations and transitives in lockfile; exact pins, ranges, conflicting or multiple locked versions; prod/dev scopes
expected: Only direct rows; exact versions carry provenance and unresolved rows remain visible; JSON/Markdown/table agree

scenario: Gradle root declarations using the default version catalog; Swift computed declarations; empty manifest
expected: Only referenced catalog entries become rows; unsupported dynamic syntax reports partial; valid empty manifest returns empty success

scenario: Offline list and list --check with duplicate exact releases, unresolved ranges and advisory titles
expected: Offline mode makes no requests; enrichment deduplicates checks, displays shared age/latest/verdict/titles, and preserves rows with review/fail at exit 1

scenario: Exact check with unavailable latest metadata or untitled advisory
expected: Latest remains null without changing verdict; untitled advisory retains ID; latest metadata never substitutes checked version
